# astern

> Look astern: mine your past Claude Code sessions for recurring problems, friction, rewritten code, and the vocabulary gap between you and your agents

- [astern.turns](_autosummary/astern.turns.html.md): From raw transcript records to one record per user→assistant turn, plus session meta.
